scope: runtime InputMap semantic pulse source, debugger generation and receipts, editor viewport capture
spatial camera, selected transform, mesh ray, native polygon/tile/animation actions

resolved_findings.problem: Using general Input.action_release cleared concurrent device/API input.
resolved_findings.resolution: Dedicated unbound native semantic source is merged independently and releases only its own state.

resolved_findings.problem: Viewport size was a non-JSON Vector2 in confirmation state.
resolved_findings.resolution: Capture confirmation size is now a two-element JSON array.

resolved_findings.problem: InputMap names and received runtime dictionary were not bounded.
resolved_findings.resolution: Actions limited by count, per-name length and total bytes; received receipt limited to 8192 JSON bytes and bounded request ID.

resolved_findings.problem: Reading animation/tile state inserted observer metadata into serializable edited resources.
resolved_findings.resolution: Observer strong references now belong to the editor UndoRedoManager rather than edited Resource metadata.

resolved_findings.problem: Finite old transform multiplied by a bounded scale could produce nonfinite output before setter.
resolved_findings.resolution: Resulting transform and determinant are checked before mutation.

resolved_findings.problem: Viewport setters did not propagate failed/mismatched readback.
resolved_findings.resolution: Readback failure is propagated and actual camera fields compared against requested fields, with numeric tolerance only on the result, not confirmation state.

resolved_findings.problem: Allowed property name alone did not establish that an animation target had an applicable scalar native property.
resolved_findings.resolution: Existing and new property tracks verify get_native succeeds with a bounded scalar value; no scripted getter is invoked. Invalid class/property combinations are rejected.

resolved_findings.problem: Animation paths alone could resolve a replaced node under the same path after a preview.
resolved_findings.resolution: Confirmation state binds each existing animated node instance/parent and the newly added track target instance/parent, in addition to animation root and edited-scene identity.

resolved_findings.problem: Native Animation setter signals could synchronously release the final scene reference to the edited resource.
resolved_findings.resolution: NativeSpatialEdit::animation retains a strong local Ref<Animation> throughout every setter, copy and readback.

assessment: No unresolved blocking issue identified in the reviewed source snapshot; compilation and business fixture evidence are separate.
limits: Independent of runtime/spatial implementation; reviewer also authored complex control and CodeBuddy JS changes, which are excluded from this independent review.
Static review is not a claim that all windows or platforms were exercised.
Dedicated input source preserves simulated device state; no actual keyboard, pointer or physical controller verification was performed by this reviewer.
Pulse duration uses the unscaled game main loop; debugger breaks may defer timer release and completion receipt.
Capture is editor viewport only; headless rejection does not verify rendered PNG capture, native menus, OS windows, IME or hardware.
Spatial actions retain explicit native data/type/ownership/capacity limits and do not cover all plugin gizmos, render geometry or native drawing tools.
review_round: Final scoped source reinspection after native scalar applicability, animated-node identity and strong-reference lifetime fixes; fixture execution remains separate.
